name: @mkbabb/glass-ui-tests-visual
description: AX.W00 — the fail-CLOSED π visual-runtime workspace. DEV-ONLY: carries Playwright + the headless WebGPU/WebGL2 device backend OFF the library's zero-dep publish surface (NOT in glass-ui dependencies/peerDependencies, NOT in dist/exports). Renders the real demo on a real device, reads back canvas pixels, and asserts on the painted image.

scripts.gate:pixel-floor: rm -f .cache/pi-report-green.json; PI_REPORT=.cache/pi-report-green.json playwright test substrate-paints-color.spec.ts --project=chromium-headless-new; node pi-gate-verify.mjs --expect=green --report=./.cache/pi-report-green.json
scripts.gate:pixel-floor:planted: rm -f .cache/pi-report-planted.json; PI_PLANT=all PI_REPORT=.cache/pi-report-planted.json playwright test substrate-paints-color.spec.ts --project=chromium-headless-new; node pi-gate-verify.mjs --expect=planted-red --report=./.cache/pi-report-planted.json --plant=all
scripts.gate:pixel-floor:planted:flood: rm -f .cache/pi-report-flood.json; PI_PLANT=blob-flood PI_REPORT=.cache/pi-report-flood.json playwright test substrate-paints-color.spec.ts --project=chromium-headless-new -g 'blob paints'; node pi-gate-verify.mjs --expect=planted-red --report=./.cache/pi-report-flood.json --floors=blob --plant=blob-flood
scripts.gate:pixel-floor:ci: rm -f .cache/pi-report-green.json; PI_REPORT=.cache/pi-report-green.json playwright test substrate-paints-color.spec.ts --project=chromium-headless-new -g 'blob paints'; node pi-gate-verify.mjs --expect=green --report=./.cache/pi-report-green.json --floors=blob
scripts.gate:pixel-floor:ci:planted: rm -f .cache/pi-report-planted.json; PI_PLANT=all PI_REPORT=.cache/pi-report-planted.json playwright test substrate-paints-color.spec.ts --project=chromium-headless-new -g 'blob paints'; node pi-gate-verify.mjs --expect=planted-red --report=./.cache/pi-report-planted.json --floors=blob --plant=all
